title: Bounded-Order Non-Identifiability in Latent Structure Block Models: The Fiber in Closed Form
abstract: arXiv:2611.23547v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A graphon is determined by all of its homomorphism densities, but motif-based methods use finitely many. We compute exactly what that truncation costs in a natural family: latent structure block models whose positions lie on $K$ rays, equivalently degree-corrected block models of rank two. For a given radial law, the configurations that agree on every graph with fewer than $2K-1$ vertices form a one-dimensional fiber, which we give in closed form with explicit endpoints; the friendship graph $F_{K-1}$ is its unique edge-minimal separator, so no fixed motif order serves every $K$. The separating signal is suppressed by a factor of at most $m_1^{2(K-1)}$, where $m_1$ is the mean squared slope, about $10^{-4}$ at $K=4$: detecting it from motif counts would take about $10^{15}$ nodes in a single graph, at any edge density. The information is nonetheless in the graph; the fiber belongs to the statistic, not the model. Common spectral pipeli

translated_title: 潜在结构块模型中的有界阶数不可辨识性：闭式纤维解
translated_abstract: 图子由其所有同态密度完全决定，但基于模体的方法只使用有限多个。我们在一个自然的模型族中精确计算了这种截断的代价：位置位于K条射线上的潜在结构块模型，等价于秩为2的度校正块模型。对于给定的径向律，在所有少于2K-1个顶点的图上一致的配置构成一个一维纤维，我们以带有显式端点的闭式形式给出该纤维；友谊图F_{K-1}是其唯一的边最小分离子，因此不存在对所有K都适用的固定模体阶数。分离信号最多被抑制m_1^{2(K-1)}倍，其中m_1是均方斜率，在K=4时约为10^{-4}：在任何边密度下，从模体计数中检测该信号需要单个图中约10^{15}个节点。然而，信息仍然存在于图中；纤维属于统计量本身，而非模型。常见的谱方法流程……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文为位置位于K条射线上的潜在结构块模型给出了有限阶模体计数下不可辨识配置的一维纤维闭式解，并证明友谊图F_{K-1}是唯一边最小分离子，因此不存在对所有K都适用的固定模体阶数。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a closed-form one-dimensional fiber of configurations that are non-identifiable from bounded-order motif counts in latent structure block models (positions on K rays), proving the friendship graph F_{K-1} is the unique edge-minimal separator, so no fixed motif order works for every K.
